text:
Amy (Marketing): Morning team — quick sync on landing copy + webinar routing. Need hero lines and CTA language for the three product pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private) by EOD Wed. Also want a short benchmark blurb we can use in the launch post and webinar promo.
Sam G.: Got it. Draft hero variants below — short and testable. 1) Hosted: 'Ship production LLMs in minutes. Predictable pricing, instant scale.' 2) Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU capacity for consistent throughput and SLAs.' 3) Private: 'Keep inference inside your VPC — full control, audited.' Thoughts?
Lina P.: I like the direction. For Private, swap "audited" -> "auditable" and add a one-liner about KMS support. Eg: 'Keep inference inside your VPC with KMS-backed keys.'
Ben (Growth): Routing notes: webinar signups need to be split into two funnels: product-led (trial nurture) vs enterprise (SDR). Add hidden field `product_mode` = hosted|dedicated|private, and UTM mapping: utm_campaign=tri-mode-launch, utm_content=webinar. I'll wire Marketo mapping if we have that hidden input.
Ola (Design): Heads up — hero copy shouldn't exceed 75 characters on mobile. I'll test the three lines at 360px and 680px. Also propose a compact subhead pattern: single sentence + 2-line CTA row.
Amy (Marketing): Good. Can we also get one concise benchmark sentence for the post & slides? Needs to be truthful but punchy — something like 'Reduce inference cost by up to 40% with batching, caching, and quantization.' Keep it measurable but not overpromising.
Sam G.: Draft benchmark blurbs — pick one: A) 'Benchmarked: 30–45% lower per-token cost using batching + KV cache on common workloads.' B) 'Median p50 latency under 70ms on trimmed Llama-2 workloads (config dependent).' C) 'Customers report 2–4x throughput gains when switching to dedicated pools.'
Lina P.: Prefer A + short caveat: 'Results vary by model and sequence length.' Add that on the slide footer.
Ben (Growth): For launch posts: schedule 3 posts: 1) product announcement (hero + benchmark), 2) webinar invite (register CTA), 3) case study tease. For inbound routing, trigger: if `product_mode==private` OR company size>1000 -> enterprise SDR, else trial track. I'll own the Zap/Flow.
Ola (Design): I'll mock hero variants with CTA labels: 'Start free trial' (Hosted), 'Reserve capacity' (Dedicated), 'Request private demo' (Private). Those map cleanly to Ben's routing.
Amy (Marketing): Owners confirmed — Amy drafts Hosted hero copy and two trial CTAs; Sam finishes Dedicated page copy and SLA line; Lina completes Private page language and security bullets; Ben sets up form fields + routing; Ola delivers layout mocks by Tue EOD.
Sam G.: Also propose we A/B test hero CTAs for Hosted: 'Start free trial' vs 'See performance'. KPI: registration conversion and 7-day activation rate.
Ben (Growth): Add GA event: `landing_cta_click` with label = product_mode. I'll add server-side tracking to ensure form submits are captured.
Amy (Marketing): Timeline: drafts today, internal review tomorrow, design mock + analytics wired Tue, final copy Wed noon. Publish for soft launch Thu morning and webinar next Tue.
Lina P.: I'll add a security bullet list for Private: 'VPC peering, KMS/HSM integration, SOC2 logs, air-gapped option.' Keep each bullet one short phrase.
LaunchBot: Reminder: create ticket #MK-483 in Launch board for creative assets and include screenshot of design comps.
Amy (Marketing): Cool — I'll open MK-483 and tag you all. If anyone wants to drop alternate lines, paste them here by 5pm. Thanks!
